info.name: Usama Stationary — Complete API Examples
info.description: Manual request examples for every API endpoint mounted by the backend. Set baseUrl and serverUrl, add local Superadmin credentials, and log in to populate tokens. Replace REPLACE_WITH_* variables with IDs from your API responses. JSON bodies are examples only: create/update/delete, sales, orders, shifts, and payment review requests change database state. Do not run the full collection against production. Re-select a local image/receipt file in form-data requests. The Stripe webhook requires a valid Stripe signature and cannot be invoked with the unsigned dummy body.

item.name: Check API health
item.description: Public health check; no request body.

item.name: Register customer
item.description: Public customer registration. Use a unique email for each registration.

item.name: Log in
item.description: Public login. Use the credentials for an existing local account; role is optional and is only checked against the account role.

item.name: Refresh tokens
item.description: Exchange the refresh token returned by login.

item.name: Get my profile
item.description: Returns the authenticated account profile.

item.name: Create staff account (legacy route)
item.description: Superadmin only. Choose role staff or admin; use a unique email.

item.name: Register staff
item.description: Superadmin only. Creates a staff account; use a unique email.

item.name: Register admin
item.description: Superadmin only. Creates an admin account; use a unique email.

item.name: Log in as admin
item.description: Log in as admin; saves returned access and refresh tokens for subsequent requests. Register a sample admin account first where appropriate, then set matching credential variables.

item.name: Log in as staff
item.description: Log in as staff; saves returned access and refresh tokens for subsequent requests. Register a sample staff account first where appropriate, then set matching credential variables.

item.name: Log in as customer
item.description: Log in as customer; saves returned access and refresh tokens for subsequent requests. Register a sample customer account first where appropriate, then set matching credential variables.

item.name: List users
item.description: Superadmin only. Query parameters are optional.

item.name: Get user
item.description: Superadmin only. Set userId to an existing user ID.

item.name: Update user
item.description: Superadmin only. Send one or more supported profile/status fields.

item.name: Change user role
item.description: Superadmin only. Allowed roles are admin and staff; the API does not promote users to superadmin.

item.name: Deactivate user
item.description: Superadmin only. Soft-deactivates the user; no request body.

item.name: Browse products
item.description: Public catalog search example; optional filters include q, isAvailableOnline, isActive, and lowStockOnly.

item.name: Get product
item.description: Public product detail. Set productId to an existing product ID.

item.name: Create product
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Category must already exist; this example uses the seeded stationery category.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Sample A5 Notebook",
  "sku": "API-EXAMPLE-NB-001",
  "category": "stationery",
  "unit": "piece",
  "price": 250,
  "costPrice": 150,
  "currentStock": 20,
  "reorderThreshold": 5,
  "isMadeToOrder": false,
  "isAvailableOnline": true,
  "description": "Dummy API example product",
  "branch": "Main"
}

item.name: Update product
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Send only fields to change; stock changes use the adjust-stock endpoint.

item.name: Deactivate product
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Soft-deactivates the product; no request body.

item.name: Adjust product stock
item.description: Admin or superadmin. delta must be non-zero; use a negative value to reduce stock.

item.name: Upload product image
item.description: Admin or superadmin. In Body choose form-data; attach an image file under the image key. Postman sets the multipart content type automatically.

item.name: Get product inventory log
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Set productId to an existing product ID.

item.name: List categories
item.description: Any authenticated account can list active categories.

item.name: Create category
item.description: Admin or superadmin. key must be lowercase letters, digits, and underscores; use a new key.

item.name: Update category
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Change the path key to an existing category key.

item.name: Record POS sale
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Replace productId with an in-stock product ID. clientTxnId must be unique per sale.

item.name: List POS sales
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Date/category/shift filters are optional.

item.name: Get POS sale
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Set saleId to a sale ID.

item.name: Push offline sales
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. clientTxnId makes each sale idempotent; use a fresh ID for a new example.

item.name: Pull catalog changes
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. since is optional ISO 8601 timestamp; omit it to request all available changes.

item.name: Get dashboard
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Metrics are scoped to the caller role.

item.name: Get sales report
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. period: daily, weekly, monthly, yearly; source: pos, online, all.

item.name: Get category report
item.description: Admin or superadmin. source: pos, online, all.

item.name: List active promotions
item.description: Public active promotion list; no request body.

item.name: List all promotions
item.description: Admin or superadmin; includes inactive and upcoming promotions.

item.name: Create promotion
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Dates must be valid and endDate must be after startDate; categories must be supported category keys.

item.name: Update promotion
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Set promotionId to an existing promotion ID.

item.name: Place order
item.description: Customer only. Replace productId with a product ID available for online sale.

item.name: List my orders
item.description: Customer only; returns the authenticated customer orders.

item.name: Get my order
item.description: Customer only; order must belong to the authenticated customer.

item.name: List orders
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Optional filters include status and paymentStatus.

item.name: Get order
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Set orderId to an existing order ID.

item.name: Update order status
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Allowed statuses include pending, confirmed, processing, out_for_delivery, delivered, and cancelled.

item.name: Stripe webhook
item.description: Stripe-only endpoint. Send the exact raw event body signed by Stripe in the Stripe-Signature header. An unsigned dummy event will be rejected.

item.name: Upload manual payment receipt
item.description: Customer only. Body > form-data: attach a receipt image/file using the receipt key. Postman sets multipart content type automatically.

item.name: List payments pending review
item.description: Admin or superadmin; no request body.

item.name: Review receipt payment
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Set paymentId to a payment awaiting review.

item.name: Open shift
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Optional opening cash, branch, and note.

item.name: Close shift
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. closingCashActual is required.

item.name: Get current shift
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin; returns the caller current shift or null.

item.name: List shifts
item.description: Staff see their own shifts; admins can view all.

item.name: Get shift report
item.description: Staff can view their own shift; admins can view all shifts.

item.name: List notifications
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. unreadOnly is optional.

item.name: Get unread notification count
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin.

item.name: Mark all notifications read
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. This changes notification state.

item.name: Mark notification read
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. Set notificationId to a visible notification ID.

item.name: Report inventory discrepancy
item.description: Staff, admin, or superadmin. product must be a valid 24-character product ID.

item.name: List inventory discrepancies
item.description: Staff see their own reports; admins can view reports across staff.

item.name: Resolve inventory discrepancy
item.description: Admin or superadmin. Set applyAdjustment or dismiss as needed.

item.name: List audit logs
item.description: Superadmin only. Optional filters include actor (user ID), from, and to.
